_doc: Layouts from the lazy chunks loaded via webpack module 3264 ('./<layout>.json'). x,y,w,h are in key units (1u). The site does NOT store a protocol key index in the layout: at runtime it reads the device's DEFAULT keymap (cmd 0x07, profile p, layer 0; 128 x 3-byte entries) and, for each layout key in order, assigns index = first not-yet-used slot whose computed code N(type,code1,code2) equals the layout key's `code` (store.updateDefaultKeys, pretty line ~12753). Do the same in the new configurator. `demoIndex` = the index (computed here with modifier entries normalised through N(), i.e. code1 bitmask -> 224..231) the site would assign in DEMO mode, where the layout's own `codes` array stands in for the device default keymap; it is a good guess for the real slot order but is UNVERIFIED against hardware. Fn key: code 255 (default entry type 240,code1 255). Modifiers: code 224..231 (default entries type 16 with code1=modifier bitmask).

K68_Ultra_UK.usedBy: NOT referenced by the device table (present in lazy chunk map only)
